title: AgentSound vocalset-choir: an SATB vowel choir built from the real singers of VocalSet
attribution: Wilkins, J., Prem Seetharaman, Alison Wahl, & Bryan Pardo. (2018). VocalSet: A Singing Voice Dataset (Version 1.2) [Dataset]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.1442513
paper: J. Wilkins, P. Seetharaman, A. Wahl, B. Pardo: "VocalSet: A Singing Voice Dataset", Proceedings of the 19th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR), Paris, 2018.
changes: Derived work: segments of the VocalSet long tones / scales / arpeggios (straight, pp, forte, slow piano / forte; vowels a e i o u) cut, pitch-shifted by at most 2 semitones, their sustains extended from their own audio, level-matched, placed in a simulated hall and summed per note into section samples (one real singer per take).
restrictions: CC BY 4.0: may be shared, redistributed and published (also commercially) WITH the attribution above and a note that the samples were changed. Unlike the DiffSinger choir packs (local only) this pack MAY be published with attribution.
